decisions.reason: The source refines keyword selection and messaging language; it does not necessarily change the existing reference-led creative concept direction.
Rejecting generic keywords does not change the independent sourcing or testimonial-style presentation requirements.
The same source message already establishes Hindi-only scripting under this candidate, and no additional update or removal is required.
The source changes keyword policy but does not alter the current requirement for a direct, Indian-market-aligned opening hook.
The source rejects specific generic wording but does not modify the requirement that the creative have a viral style.
The keyword revision does not change the defined audience age range or Indian-market scope.
The source contains no decision about the call-to-action or closing sequence.
The messaging revision does not resolve or alter the production-method conflict concerning live-action and AI-generated visuals.
The source does not discuss lip-sync accuracy or facial-expression requirements.
Requiring reference-derived keywords and a Hindi script does not change who must create or supply the script, footage, or voiceover.
The CPL concern motivates the messaging change but does not alter the existing conversion objective, target CPL, or optimization priority.
The source does not change the pilot quantity, duration, formats, or follow-on ordering condition.
